name: Stomatal Apparatus (Open & Closed Guard Cells)
semanticDescription: Microscopic leaf stomatal apparatus with dual presentation collections: Stoma_Open (NCERT Fig 5.3a turgid kidney-shaped guard cells, open stomatal aperture, thickened inner walls, chloroplasts, nucleus, and rising transpiration vapor stream) and Stoma_Closed (NCERT Fig 5.3b flaccid guard cells touching along the inner wall seam, completely sealing the pore against transpiration).
simplifications: Differential wall elasticity illustrated via thicker concave inner boundary mesh.
Chloroplasts shown as distinct green lens-shaped organelles within guard cell cytoplasm.
Transpiration vapor stream rendered as rising illuminated H2O droplets.

materials.look: Translucent cellular green cytoplasm (roughness 0.30, transmission 0.20, subsurface 0.30)
Thick rigid inelastic cellulose inner wall lining (deep emerald green)
Vibrant photosynthetic chloroplast granules (bright grass green)
Pavement epidermal cells with light translucent cellular matrix
